scope: Strict OpenAPI and runtime response contracts for six private location-scoped Gateway read routes.

contracts.details: Validates review blockers, creator attribution, source-reference counts and scopes, location/page identity, and fixed content bounds. Supports migration-backed network/location source labels and worker_task_unregistered without exposing arbitrary fields.
Validates the canonical version snapshot blocks, canvas/location identity, timestamp, and bounded continuation; retains the 512 KiB response guard.
Validates migration-aligned summary counts, event statuses, timestamps, exact location, and request-bound pagination.
Validates source-derived soil and input/removal projections, schema enums, finite quantities, cost classification, event-type consistency, exact location, totals, and terminal pagination.

not_verified: No live database, candidate/legacy service, or provider was used.
These tests establish source/API behavior, not populated-data parity, live OIDC/browser behavior, or broader tenant/RLS acceptance.
The runtime SQL inventory only changed AI-summary source line references; all 37 unresolved-write candidates and the review ledger remain unchanged, and no database grants changed.
Capability classifications and MAN-CAP acceptance remain unchanged.
